components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Segmented Control

components.css: .ds-split { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; gap: 3px; width: 360px; font: 13px Archivo, sans-serif; color: #11141b; } .ds-split li { min-width: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 8px 6px; background: #eceef2; border-bottom: 3px solid #b2b8c3; } .ds-split li:nth-child(1) { flex: 5; } .ds-split li:nth-child(2) { flex: 30; } .ds-split li:nth-child(3) { flex: 10; } .ds-split .past { border-bottom-color: #0d7a5c; } .ds-split .now { border-bottom-color: #2b3fe0; background: #e5e9ff; font-weight: 650; }

components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; width: 360px; border: 1px solid #d5d9e0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f8f9fb; overflow: hidden; } .ds-code-bar { padding: 4px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7eaf0; background: #fff; font: 600 12px Archivo, sans-serif; color: #454c5b; } .ds-code pre { margin: 0; padding: 12px 0; font: 400 13px/1.7 "Martian Mono", monospace; font-stretch: 84%; counter-reset: ln; } .ds-code .ln { display: block; padding: 0 20px 0 calc(4ch + 20px); position: relative; white-space: pre; } .ds-code .ln::before { counter-increment: ln; content: counter(ln); position: absolute; left: 0; width: 3.4ch; text-align: right; color: #5f6778; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-code .hl { background: rgb(43 63 224 / 0.1); }

narrative.overview:
Offer Ready treats interview prep as an athletic training season, not a backlog. A coach's periodization log sets the grammar: one season, a weekly load, a race day. The owner opens it at night and sees the day and phase, the distance to offer day, and tonight's three items with times. The surface refuses the category default of a sidebar plus a grid of topic cards with progress bars. Structure comes from hairline rules, tabular numerals and shape-coded marks instead of card chrome.

The voice is precise and instrument-like, with a textbook warmth in the reading pages. Graphite neutrals tinted cool carry everything. One timing-blue accent is reserved for action, selection and the live week. Numbers are the hero: LeetCode numbers and week counts are set as race-bib numerals in condensed Archivo, and every place data lives uses tabular figures. Radii are small, like instrument bezels.

Light ("day session") and dark ("night session") are both first-class and follow the OS unless the owner picks one. The Season Chart on Home is the signature moment: the whole season drawn as a periodization chart, this week's bar filling as the owner studies, scrubbable by pointer or arrow keys with a pace line showing ahead or behind.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules and tabular numerals instead of card chrome; a 2px ink rule opens a list or table, 1px lines separate rows.
Race-bib numerals (Archivo at 62% width, weight 850) for problem numbers, week numbers, countdowns and stats.
One accent, timing blue, on action, selection and "now".
Difficulty coded by shape and color together (circle green, diamond amber, triangle red), readable in both themes.
Small radii (3, 5, 8px), flat surfaces, shadows only on floating layers.
A dark graphite rail on the left in both themes; the content canvas flips, the rail stays night.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Timing blue marks action, selection or "now" and nothing else. Status and difficulty never borrow it.

rules.name: The Shape Plus Hue Rule
rules.body: Easy, Medium, Hard and problem status are always a color with a distinct shape; hue alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The Night Rail Rule
rules.body: The rail is graphite in both themes; only the canvas flips.

rules.name: The Bib Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number that is an identity or a score (LeetCode number, week, countdown, tally) is a condensed tabular bib numeral, never body text.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Wherever data lives, use tabular figures so columns and timers do not jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Content surfaces carry no shadow; only the selected segment, flashcard and floating layers do.

rules.name: The Top Rule Rule
rules.body: Emphasis on a block is a top rule (2px ink for lists, 3px for cards such as pipeline cards and example blocks), never a colored side stripe.

dos: Do open lists and tables with a 2px ink rule and separate rows with 1px hairlines; use a 3px top rule for emphasized blocks.
Do set identity and score numbers as condensed bib numerals with tabular figures.
Do code Easy, Medium and Hard with both color and shape (circle, diamond, triangle) in both themes.
Do reserve timing blue for action, selection and the live week.
Do keep radii at 3, 5 or 8px and surfaces flat; put shadows only on floating layers.
Do keep focus visible (2px accent outline) and honor reduced motion via the duration tokens.
Do let the Season Chart stay the signature; new surfaces borrow its hairline-and-numeral grammar.
donts: Don't return to a sidebar-plus-grid-of-topic-cards-with-progress-bars layout; the product brief rejects it.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders on cards or rows; use a top rule instead (the owner replaced them).
Don't make it look like a generic Tailwind/shadcn dashboard or a GeeksforGeeks clone.
Don't rely on hue alone for difficulty, status or pace.
Don't introduce a second accent color or large pill radii.
